qol.timeStopProjectiles Description: Freeze projectiles while the game is paused.
qol.disableAnalytics Description: Opt-out of analytics sent to the developers.
qol.displayFPS Description: Display an FPS counter on the top left-hand side of the screen.
qol.maxFrameRate Description: Adjust the max frame rate limit. VSync and FPS 30 Lock must be disabled in settings.
qol.hideWelcomeWindow Description: Hides the window that appears when the game launches.
optimizations.actorJobFlatten Descriptio: Flattens main actor jobs into one loop.
optimizations.drawMapLayerThrottle Descr: Throttles map layer drawing to every third frame.
optimizations.fastMinimapRenderer Descri: Updates individual tiles instead of whole chunks.
optimizations.lazyZoneCamera Description: Disables visible zone update while the camera isn't moving.
optimizations.mouseCursorFix Description: Disables raytracing to detect ui elements below the cursor.
optimizations.powerButtonSelectorFix Des: Disables checking if every power is premium locked every frame.
optimizations.powersTabUpdateThrottle De: Throttles power tab auto-format to every 15th frame.
optimizations.quantumSpriteThrottle Desc: Throttles quantum sprite drawing to every other frame.
optimizations.uiWorldAgeFix Description: Caches state and disables expensive tweening operations.
